front: How does a standing wave form?
back: Superposition of two waves with the same frequency, speed and amplitude travelling in opposite directions.
Node: zero amplitude. Antinode: maximum amplitude. Adjacent nodes are λ/2 apart.

front: Harmonics of a string fixed at both ends?
Harmonics of a pipe closed at one end?
Harmonics of a pipe open at both ends?
back: Same as a string: $\lambda_n = 2L/n$, all harmonics.
Large amplitude when the driving frequency equals the natural frequency.
Light: oscillates with decaying amplitude. Critical: fastest return, no oscillation. Heavy: slow return, no oscillation.
